ART_11a047c8.name: Simulating Classroom Education with LLM-Empowered Agents
ART_11a047c8.source: Simulating Classroom Education with LLM-Empowered Agents
ART_11a047c8.full_code:
graph TD
    subgraph User_View
        direction TB
        subgraph Left_Panel
            direction TB
            Dialogue_History(Dialogue History)
            User_Input["Interact with the class here ..."]
        end
        subgraph Right_Panel
            direction TB
            subgraph Class_Roles_Config["Class Roles"]
                Teacher_Config[Teacher]
                Assistant_Config[Assistant]
                Classmates_Config[Classmate(s)]
                User_Config[User]
            end
            Current_Slide(Current Slide)
        end
    end

    subgraph System_Backend
        direction TB
        subgraph Class_Session_Controller
            direction LR
            Class_State_Receptor --> Manager
            Manager --> Select_a_Function
            Manager --> Select_a_Speaker
        end
        subgraph Class_Roles_Execution["Class Roles"]
            Teacher
            Assistant
            Classmates
        end
        Learning_Materials(Learning Materials)
        Role_Descriptions(Role Descriptions)
    end

    User_Input --"DU"--> Class_State_Receptor
    Dialogue_History --"DT, DA, DC"--> Dialogue_History
    Class_Roles_Execution --"DT, DA, DC"--> Dialogue_History
    Dialogue_History --"HT"--> Class_State_Receptor
    Current_Slide --"CT"--> Class_State_Receptor
    Role_Descriptions --"HU"--> Class_State_Receptor
    Select_a_Speaker --"C1,C2,...,Cn"--> Class_Roles_Execution
    
    classDef user_view_style fill:#f9f,stroke:#333,stroke-width:2px
    class User_View user_view_style
    classDef backend_style fill:#ccf,stroke:#333,stroke-width:2px
    class System_Backend backend_style
